```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(MATH4753)
set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
x <- rbeta(30, 3, 4)
a_vals <- seq(1, 6, length = 50)
b_vals <- seq(1, 6, length = 50)
result <- mymlbeta(x, a_vals, b_vals)
result
```

```{r}
ntickets(N = 400, gamma = 0.02, p = 0.95)
```

```{r}
myboot2(x = rnorm(20), fun = "mean")
```

```{r}
loglik_binom <- function(y, p) dbinom(y, size = 20, prob = p, log = TRUE)
y <- c(3, 3, 4, 3, 4, 5, 5, 4)
pvals <- seq(0.01, 0.5, length = 100)
mymaxlik(loglik_binom, y, pvals)
```

```{r}
data(mtbe_data)
summary(mtbe_data)
plot(mtbe_data$DevPct, mtbe_data$`MTBE-Level`,
     main = "MTBE Level vs Development",
     xlab = "% Developed Land", ylab = "MTBE Level (µg/L)")
```
